entries.en: Added SlashCommand tool, which enables Claude to invoke your slash commands. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/slash-commands#SlashCommand-tool
entries.zh: 添加了 SlashCommand 工具，使 Claude 能够调用斜杠命令。 https://code.claude.com/docs/en/slash-commands#SlashCommand-tool

entries.en: Bash permission rules now support output redirections when matching (e.g., `Bash(python:*)` matches `python script.py > output.txt`)
entries.zh: Bash 权限规则现在支持匹配时的输出重定向（例如，`Bash(python:*)`匹配`python script.py > output.txt`）
增强的 BashTool 环境快照日志记录

entries.en: Migrated --debug logging to a file, to enable easy tailing & filtering
entries.zh: --debug 日志改为写入文件，便于用 tail 实时查看和过滤

entries.en: Fixed thinking mode triggering on negation phrases like "don't think"
entries.zh: 修复思考模式会被"don't think"这类否定短语误触发的问题

entries.en: Fixed rendering performance degradation during token streaming
entries.zh: 修复了令牌流期间渲染性能下降的问题

entries.en: Fixed a bug where resuming a conversation in headless mode would sometimes enable thinking unnecessarily
entries.zh: 修复了在无头模式下恢复对话有时会导致不必要的思考的错误
